LESSON: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Belief in revealed scriptures
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Belief in revealed scriptures, part of Pillars of Iman in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: how to show tolerance towards people of other faiths and make notes. 1. How can Muslims practise religious tolerance?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
